resources.string:
inkOS:wndr needs accessibility service access to perform this gesture action (lock screen, recent apps, quick settings, or power dialog).

This service only performs the system action you assigned. It does not read screen content, collect personal data, or transmit any information. All processing stays on your device.

You will be taken to accessibility settings to enable inkOS:wndr actions.
inkOS:wndr needs notification access to show your notifications here. You will be taken to Android settings to grant this permission.
inkOS:wndr needs to be the default home screen to access private space.

inkOS:wndr wallpaper is a "faux" wallpaper, it's an image that appears over the actual android wallpaper layer.

It's function it's meant to circumvent Android cropping and zooming in your wallpaper which might break the the 1:1 pixel scaling which can cause defect to your image especially if you're using an e-ink device.

Make sure to use correct aspect ratio, or have the exact resolution as your display.

Setting an Android wallpaper will automatically clear the inkOS:wndr wallpaper.
inkOS:wndr does not track you. We cannot collect, store, or share your data because inkOS:wndr does not have the capability to access or transmit your personal information.
inkOS:wndr does not connect to any servers. All functionality operates entirely on your device. There is no network communication and no external connections.
inkOS:wndr only previews and displays data that already exists on your phone. All app information, notifications, and settings are processed locally. Nothing leaves your device.
inkOS:wndr is open source. You can review the source code on GitHub to verify these claims.

inkOS:wndr uses this accessibility service for two things: to perform the system actions you assign to gestures (lock screen, open recent apps, open quick settings, open the power dialog), and to show music controls on the lock screen for players other than Mudita\'s own. For the second it watches only the system lock screen, to know when it is showing and whether the PIN pad is up. It does not read other apps, and it does not collect, store or share anything. No data leaves your device.
